pure-announcement.rationale: Reference or research material, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: Nothing in the corpus covers link-analysis ranking; the retrieval ADR references it but no concept holds it.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published, cited material; claims checkable at the linked source.

durability.rationale: Link-analysis ranking by recursive importance with damping — the founding web-graph algorithm, patents expired, variants (personalized/topic-sensitive) documented.

actionability.rationale: The algorithm, damping factor, and iterative computation are specified concretely enough to implement and to critique.

atomicity.rationale: One algorithm with its variants and known manipulation modes.
